description:
Diagram 17, "Flue outlet positions for solid fuel appliances", shows an axonometric line drawing of a pitched-roof structure labelled "Regulated building", with a structure to the upper right labelled "Adjacent building". A dormer-style opening sits on the main roof slope. Four vertical flue pipes are drawn at positions A (at the left end of the ridge), B (on the main slope), C (on the main slope, beside the dormer opening) and D (at the right end of the ridge, near the adjacent building).

Below the drawing, a two-column table headed "Point where flue passes through weather surface (Notes 1, 2)" and "Clearances to flue outlet" lists rows A to D, each with a description of the position and the corresponding clearance text. Notes 1 to 4 follow. To the right of the table is a small section of a flue pipe marked "150mm max.", with pointers labelled "Datum for horizontal measurements" and "Datum for vertical measurements", and a caption stating the vertical datum is the point of discharge of the flue, or 150mm above the insulation, whichever is the lower.
